text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Canary failures detected for Brightwave dedicated VPC pool (pool-id: brightwave-prod-3). 5xx rate spiking to 22% on shard 2, latency p90 -> 1.2s. Triggered at 2026-03-14T22:12Z :rotating_light:

sam (oncall): seeing it. paging oncall. assigning to priya.

priya (runtime): I'm on. initial triage: failures correlated with model artifact id: rwd-infer:v2026-03-14-07 (quantized). Errors are `KV cache mismatch` in logs.

nina (sre): how broad? is customer traffic only or affecting multiple tenants?

priya (runtime): looks tenant-scoped to Brightwave dedicated pool nodes (10/40 GPUs). Other customers on same k8s cluster unaffected.

mara (Brightwave Ops): we're seeing errors in production - our chat flows are dropping messages. is this impacting session affinity?

sam (oncall): @mara sorry - we're investigating. can you confirm if any critical flows are blocked (billing, auth)?

mara (Brightwave Ops): chat ingestion and summarization affected. auth/billing OK. It's customer-visible. priority: high.

jordi (release): checked deploy history. Canary rollout started at 21:50Z to 10% (pool shard 2). Artifact rwd-infer:v2026-03-14-07 promoted from canary. release-bot: deploy id 3872.

release-bot: CANARY_UPDATE: deployment 3872 -> artifact rwd-infer:v2026-03-14-07 -> canary targets: brightwave-prod-3-shard2

leo (infra): node-level health shows increased OOMs on those GPUs? logs show repetitive CUDA OOMs around the same timestamps. could be quantized kernel mismatch with driver 525.85.

priya (runtime): reproducer: run inference with payload size ~6k tokens using the new artifact on identical instance -> hits `KV cache mismatch`. suspect model artifact built with incompatible kv-shape.

sam (oncall): decision needed: pinback to previous artifact or roll forward with hotfix. We need customer mitigation ASAP.

jordi (release): previous artifact is rwd-infer:v2026-03-07-12. We can pin that and rollback the canary in ~3m. Can do a targeted pin for brightwave pool only.

priya (runtime): recommended: immediate pinback to v2026-03-07-12 for brightwave-prod-3, keep rest of canary paused. Also add a runtime guard to reject large-internal-kv shapes until we validate.

nina (sre): agree. apply pin + scale down canary for that shard. Also start CPU/GPU isolation to avoid cross-tenant impact.

sam (oncall): @jordi please pin and rollback for brightwave shard2. @priya coordinate runtime guard change. I'll notify Brightwave ops.

jordi (release): executing targeted pin now: `rctl artifact pin --tenant brightwave --pool brightwave-prod-3 --artifact rwd-infer:v2026-03-07-12`

release-bot: ACTION: artifact pin accepted. change-id=chg-6612. Performing canary rollback on shard2.

jordi (release): running: `kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deploy/brightwave-infer --to-revision=20260307-12 --context=prod-brightwave` (targeted pods only).

priya (runtime): applying runtime guard: `export RW_RUNTIME_KV_SHAPE_MAX=4096` to canary env for shard2 and restart of the runtime process.

leo (infra): isolating the GPU nodes from shared scheduling and tainting them: `kubectl taint nodes gpu-brightwave-11 dedicated=brightwave:NoSchedule` so nothing else gets moved.

mara (Brightwave Ops): thanks. any ETA to see user traffic recover?

sam (oncall): expect rollback to finish in ~4-6 minutes; then another 3-5 minutes for sessions to rehydrate. will confirm.

(4m later)

release-bot: ROLLBACK_COMPLETE: deployment brightwave-infer -> revision 20260307-12 applied to shard2. change-id=chg-6612.

priya (runtime): seeing error rate drop to 1.2% on shard2. latency p90 back to ~320ms. KV mismatch logs gone on restarted pods.

nina (sre): monitoring metrics: requests succeed, CPU/GPU stable, no OOM after rollback.

mara (Brightwave Ops): confirmed flows are healthy on our side. thank you.

sam (oncall): Great. next steps: 1) keep pinned artifact for brightwave until release team provides validated build 2) run artifact validation suite (kv-shape, quant kernels) against driver 525.85 3) schedule postmortem with Brightwave and internal teams (root cause expected: build produced incompatible KV layout for this driver).

jordi (release): I'll keep the pin in place and schedule a rebuild. estimated ETA for a validated artifact: 48 hours.

priya (runtime): will run extended validation and add a unit to CI to check kv-shape compatibility across drivers.

sam (oncall): I'm closing the incident channel but will keep watch for 30m. tagging this as P1 -> mitigated. creating follow-up ticket: TKT-8891.

sam (oncall): FYI @mara we'll share the postmortem and timeline. thanks for patience. :white_check_mark:

mara (Brightwave Ops): appreciated. pls also add our security/privacy contact to the postmortem.

jordi (release): noted. attaching deploy logs and artifact checksum to TKT-8891.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status -> mitigated; impact -> customer-visible errors for Brightwave; action -> targeted rollback and pin; owner -> jordi (release); ticket -> TKT-8891.

sam (oncall): closing thread. if any regression, reopen and @sam.

(End of thread)
